Description: The wielder of this weapon uses their Agility modifier to hit and damage instead of their Strength modifier.
A successful backstab with this weapon inflicts 1d10 damage.
Easier to conceal than most hand-to-hand weapons. It can be hidden in a pocket.
Strength modifier for damage applies with this weapon at close range only.
This weapon inflicts double damage on a mounted charge.
It takes a movement action to reload this weapon.
This weapon can strike targets up to 10’ away.
Characters using two-handed weapons use a d16 for initiative checks and may not wield a second weapon or a shield while using it.
